title: Bumblebee with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='30' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#bfe8ff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-25 34 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='30' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#bfe8ff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(25 66 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='30' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#e8f7ff' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(-25 34 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='30' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#e8f7ff' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(25 66 30)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M27 52 Q50 46 73 52 L72 60 Q50 54 28 60 Z' fill='#6b4a1b'/>
  <path d='M28 68 Q50 62 72 68 L71 76 Q50 70 29 76 Z' fill='#6b4a1b'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='16' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='16' fill='#ffdd66' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M42 21 Q36 12 33 8' stroke='#6b4a1b' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='7' r='3' fill='#6b4a1b'/>
  <path d='M58 21 Q64 12 67 8' stroke='#6b4a1b' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='7' r='3' fill='#6b4a1b'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='32' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='32' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='32' r='4' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='32' r='4' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='30.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55.5' cy='30.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='34' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='34' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars around eyes -->
  <path d='M48 24 L49 27 L52 28 L49 29 L48 32 L47 29 L44 28 L47 27 Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M62 22 L63 24.5 L65.5 25.5 L63 26.5 L62 29 L61 26.5 L58.5 25.5 L61 24.5 Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M36 25 L36.8 27 L38.8 27.8 L36.8 28.6 L36 30.6 L35.2 28.6 L33.2 27.8 L35.2 27 Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 40 Q50 44 55 40' stroke='#6b4a1b' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M50 83 L47 90 L53 90 Z' fill='#6b4a1b'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <path d='M25 55 Q18 50 16 44' stroke='#6b4a1b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M75 55 Q82 50 84 44' stroke='#6b4a1b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M40 82 Q37 88 34 89' stroke='#6b4a1b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 82 Q63 88 66 89' stroke='#6b4a1b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='38' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ff9966' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='38' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ff9966' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
